description: Application view model for indent tracker data (not stored as a database table), linked to indent header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report indent tracker records for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One object represents one indent tracker result row.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the indent tracker.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: indent_code
columns.description: Indent code reference of the indent tracker.

columns.name: indent_headerId
columns.description: Reference to the indent header linked to this indent tracker.

relationships.description: Each indent tracker references one indent header (indent header).

business_rules: created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Columns type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Indent Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
IndentTracker is an application view model or report DTO populated in code, not a table stored in the database.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against IndentTracker: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting indent tracker records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: indent_headerId = IndentHeader.id.
Populated in application code (for example from a stored procedure or joined query); query the underlying tables instead.
